desktop.notes:
• Videos (MP4 / MOV): the picture plays now, not only the sound; starts in a fraction of a second. H.264, H.265 (HEVC), VP9, AV1, ProRes.
• GIFs play in the grid (the ones on screen) and the selected video loops its first 2 s there.
• Media filter: Photo · Animation (GIF) · Video.
• Play toggle button next to ⓘ at the bottom (same as ⚙ → Play GIFs & videos). ⓘ = hover for the keyboard keys.
